IC1: History of any chemotherapy for MBC.
IC2: An interval of < 6 months from the completion of cytotoxic chemotherapy in the neo-adjuvant or adjuvant setting until the time of metastatic diagnosis.
IC4: Hormone therapy < 7 days prior to randomization.
IC6: History of other malignancy within the last 5 years, [NOT] except for appropriately treated carcinoma in situ of the cervix [OR], non-melanoma skin carcinoma [OR], Stage [AND] I uterine cancer, or other cancers with a similar outcome as those previously mentioned.
IC7: Previous radiotherapy for the treatment of unresectable [OR], locally advanced [OR] or metastatic breast cancer is not allowed if more than 25% of marrow-bearing bone has been irradiated or the last fraction of radiotherapy has been administered within approximately 3 weeks prior to randomization.
IC8: Brain metastases [OR] that are untreated [OR], symptomatic [OR], or require therapy to control symptoms or any radiation [OR], surgery [OR], or other therapy to control symptoms from brain metastases within 2 months prior to randomization.
IC9: History of exposure to the following cumulative doses of anthracyclines: Doxorubicin [OR] or liposomal doxorubicin > 500 mg/m^2; epirubicin > 900 mg/m^2; mitoxantrone > 120mg/m^2 and idarubicin > 90 mg/m^2.
IC11: History of symptomatic congestive heart failure [OR], or ventricular arrhythmia requiring treatment.
IC12: History of myocardial infarction within 6 months prior to randomization.
IC13: Left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) below 50% within approximately 28 days prior to randomization.
IC14: History of decreased LVEF [OR] or symptomatic congestive heart failure (CHF) with previous adjuvant trastuzumab treatment.
IC15: Cardiac troponin I ≥ 0.2 ng/mL within 28 days of randomization.
IC16: Severe dyspnea at rest because of complications [OR] of advanced malignancy or requiring current continuous oxygen therapy.
IC17: Current severe, uncontrolled systemic disease [AND] (eg, clinically significant cardiovascular [OR], pulmonary [OR], or metabolic disease [OR]; wound healing disorders [OR]; ulcers [OR]; or bone fractures).
IC18: Major surgical procedure [OR] or significant traumatic injury [OR] within approximately 28 days prior to randomization or anticipation of the need for major surgery during the course of study treatment.
IC20: History of receiving any investigational treatment within approximately 28 days prior to randomization.
IC21: Current known infection with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) [OR], active hepatitis B [OR] and/or hepatitis C virus.
IC22: History of intolerance [OR] (including Grade [AND] 3-4 infusion reaction) or hypersensitivity to trastuzumab [OR], murine proteins [OR], or docetaxel.
IC23: Known hypersensitivity to any of the study drugs [OR], including the excipients, or any drugs formulated in polysorbate 80.
IC24: Assessed by the investigator to be unable [OR] or unwilling to comply with the requirements of the protocol.
